typed_ports.name: address_state
typed_ports.normalization: trace=1 over n=2..N; vacuum n=1 excluded
typed_ports.required: weights plus source hash, admission history and recovery rule

typed_ports.name: branch_instrument
typed_ports.required: four microscopic branches; coarse return is density sum

typed_ports.name: conditional_internal_state
typed_ports.normalization: trace=1 conditional on phi; weighted state trace=f_phi
typed_ports.required: basis, Hamiltonian, species label, current operators, Q2 in GeV^2

typed_ports.name: carrier_state
typed_ports.required: 128-site carrier is distinct from 95-dimensional nucleon space

typed_ports.name: energy
typed_ports.normalization: extensive energy at declared volume and population
typed_ports.required: MeV conversion, particle number, supply and signed environment exchange

typed_ports.name: pressure
typed_ports.normalization: -partial E/partial V at specified fixed state variables

typed_ports.name: clock
typed_ports.normalization: frame order is dimensionless; proper time is worldline-specific
typed_ports.required: generator and calibration; null means unassigned

typed_ports.name: record
typed_ports.normalization: ensemble and sampled outcome kept separate
typed_ports.required: instrument, conditional state, medium energy, persistence interval
